objective: Close C36 mixed cone d5 by a global equitable C-side owner map and a single aggregate long-leaf edge-color repair, with loss O(r) independent of q.

atomic_claims.text: For q>0, ell5 dominance implies a>=c, q<=a, c+q>=a+1, and q(a-c)>=a*max(0,a-1-p).

A bounded C residue repair, selected Kirkman CCC factors, and an equitable a-edge-coloring of their regular complement give edge-disjoint ACC owners and a remaining betaAC graph with controlled degrees.

After adding only max(0,a-1-p-7) AA factor classes to beta, the aggregate long-resource graph has Delta<=q+7; one Delta+1 coloring deletes at most eight matching color classes and produces actual q long-leaf matchings.
On d5, nu_star-nu<=13r and therefore cp<=lambda+26r<n^2/6+27n.
Generator-side checking covers 1,745,949 d5-dominant q>0 rows, five actual owner witnesses and 12/12 mutations; finite checks do not prove the universal result.
